column1: # Tagalog roots and the affixation paradigms they take.  The modeling module
# expands every line into its inflected forms (data/tagalog_inflections.txt).
# classes:  um    kumain kumakain kakain           mag   magluto nagluto nagluluto pagluluto
#           ma    matulog natulog natutulog       maka  makakain nakakain nakakakain
#           in    kainin kinain kinakain kakainin an    puntahan pinuntahan pupuntahan
#           i     isama isinama isinasama isasama pagan pag-aralan pinag-aralan
#           adj   maganda magaganda napakaganda pinakamaganda kagandahan
# A trailing ' marks a glottal-final root: no linking h before -in/-an
# (luto' -> lutuin, not lutuhin).  The optional suffix stem is used before
# -in/-an for syncope or sound change (dala -> dalhin, bayad -> bayaran).
# ---- adjectives (ma- adjectives; most also take -um- "to become") --------------
